capabilities: Sync notes and attachments across devices via a self-hosted server
Encrypt file contents and paths on-device with AES-256-GCM
Run automatic synchronization with a configurable change delay and periodic check
Preserve competing changes as conflict copies and propagate deletions
Generate a diagnostics report of sync settings and result counters
extras: Server implementation is in a private repository and not publicly distributed; the plugin is not yet in the community directory and must be installed manually from GitHub releases. Generic WebDAV servers are incompatible. The author warns the sync is not a backup and recommends keeping an independent vault backup; a lost encryption key cannot be recovered.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through a server you operate with file contents and paths encrypted on the device.

requires.name: Private Sync server operated by the user

summary: Self-hosted sync plugin that synchronizes notes and attachments between devices through your own server with end-to-end encryption.
